text:
The most recent Republican to win the New York gubernatorial election was **George Pataki**, who was first elected in **1994**.  
On the 1994 ballot Pataki ran on three party lines:

| Party line | Party |
|------------|-------|
| Republican | New York Republican Party |
| Conservative | New York Conservative Party |
| Tax Cut Now | New York Tax Cut Now Party |

These lines are shown in the official 1994 election results and in the Wikipedia entry for the 1994 New York gubernatorial election, which lists George Pataki as the candidate for the Republican, Conservative, and Tax Cut Now parties【1†L71-L73】【1†L73-L74】.

**Answer:** Republican, Conservative, and Tax Cut Now.
